risk.rationale: Only confirmed finding is F2: suspicious sign-ins from a baseline-external ASN (AS9009 M247 Europe/RO), 5 events, T1078.004. No confirmed account-takeover chain (no follow-on activity, MFA compromise, mailbox/credential changes). The impossible-travel claim (Bucharest→İzmir in 12 min) was rejected and explained away: 61/61 baseline sign-ins on AS34984 Superonline plus device dev-tb-laptop already geolocating to İzmir (carrier-geolocation artefact ≥30%). No data-quality conflicts. A single unexplained baseline-external sign-in cluster is a weak unexplained signal, insufficient for contain and not explained away enough for benign.
